OFFICIAL MISSION STATEMENT:

CST LAN Challenge 2026 is a competitive Counter-Strike 2 gaming tournament bringing together talented university players to compete, demonstrate their skills, and represent their teams with honor.

Hosted and organized by the Computer Science and Technology Degree Programme, Department of Computer Science and Informatics, Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka, this landmark tournament unites the island’s sharpest strategic minds and most deadly FPS sharpshooters.

Following the success of previous LAN challenges, the 2026 edition shifts to Valve's flagship tactical shooter—Counter-Strike 2. Featuring complete volumetric smoke tactical gameplay, sub-tick server synchronization, and custom stage acoustics, every retake, clutch, and eco-round will be experienced at international major esports standards.

COMPETITION PROTOCOLS // 2026

TOURNAMENT FORMAT & STRUCTURE

Standardized competitive Counter-Strike 2 regulation format with manual tournament administration, dedicated tournament referees, and strict anti-cheat verification.

01PHASE 1

ROSTER REGISTRATION

5 Starters + 1 Optional Sub

Each university squad consists of exactly 5 active players and 1 designated optional substitute. All players must be verified undergraduate or postgraduate university students.

02PRE-MATCH

MAP VETO & BAN PHASE

Standard CS2 Competitive Veto

Captains conduct coin-toss ban/pick sequences from the Active Duty Map Pool. Higher-seeded teams choose between first ban or side selection for the opening map.

03MATCH PROTOCOL

MR12 TOURNAMENT RULES

Max Rounds 12 per Half

First team to 13 rounds claims victory. In the event of a 12-12 deadlock, MR3 Overtime with $10,000 starting cash decides the winner in intense sudden death rounds.

04CHAMPIONSHIP

LAN FINALS & PLAYOFFS

Auditorium Championship Stage

Top qualifying teams battle on the main LAN stage at Uva Wellassa University. Admin referee-supervised, zero-latency physical LAN setup with live auditorium projection.
